label: exploratory

Cells d0.00-r1.00, d0.50-r1.00, d1.00-r2.00 with P0 to P3; EXP-003 cells B-sB2, C-student_t3, C-lognormal, D-k0.1-pB0.2 with P0 and P3. 400 runs. measurements.load_average_during_recorded_execution: about 81 (1 min), from other processes on the machine
measurements.p0_analytic_check: 28 of 28 metric-cell comparisons within 3 bootstrap SE (max |z| = 2.21)

determinism: the two executions produced identical results apart from runtime and memory fields (400 of 400 run records compared)
notes: Exploratory; not evidence for any hypothesis. Effect estimates in the report are not findings and must not be quoted as results. The run includes cells whose outcome bears on EXP-003 H2; disclosed in AP-006.

label: exploratory

label: exploratory
kind: diagnosis of the EXP-003 implementation-check deviation
description: After the confirmatory EXP-003 check showed 4 of 60 comparisons outside 3 bootstrap SE, the same frozen matrix was run on exploratory seeds 1000 to 1019 (no change to code, config or analysis) and its analytic check computed: 60 of 60 within 3 SE; in the two flagged cells the largest |z| is 1.72. Suggests a realisation of the confirmatory seed set (all cells share the same 20 seeds under common random numbers, so the 60 comparisons are correlated) rather than a code fault. Exploratory; it does not change the confirmatory outcome of the check.
command: PYTHONPATH=src nice -n 10 .venv/bin/python -m rigged.cli run --experiment EXP-003 --exploratory --seed-offset 1000 --seeds 20; ... report --input results/exploratory/exp-003-x

label: exploratory
kind: M4 confounder check: P1 calibration-fit error (protocol section 11)
description: Population (infinite-n) values of P1 with the exact Gaussian posterior P(Y = 1 | X, G) in place of the 20-bin calibration map, by numerical integration (rigged.analytic._exceed), for the 12 EXP-001/EXP-002 cells, compared with the confirmatory binned P1 seed means. Primary cell: exact EOG 13.04 pp against binned 14.89 [14.30, 15.45] pp; exact PPV gap 2.10 pp against 1.00 pp. Exact value outside the binned interval in 5 of 12 cells (differences -3.86 to +7.67 pp). Integration cross-checked by an in-session Monte Carlo (4,000,000 draws per cell, seed 1234, not saved): 13.00, 22.26 and 15.18 pp against 13.04, 22.25 and 15.20 pp for d0.50-r1.00, d1.00-r1.00 and d0.00-r1.50. Exploratory; the EXP-002 verdicts are unchanged (P1 still fails SR and EO parity).

Median score of qualified members: -0.53 (A) against -0.29 (B). Logistic probability minus observed rate: -2.98 pp (A), +11.23 pp (B); Group B's observed rate is lower in every pool-wide score decile (top decile 40.12% against 74.47%). Mean age of qualified members 43.90 (A) against 48.50 (B). Exploratory and descriptive; it does not change the EXP-004 verdict and establishes no cause.
